title: Compute Configuration
description: Standardized execution resource abstractions for sizing, scaling, and isolating compute.

then.$comment: A compute without a code is the default one, whose warehouse name drops the size (WH_<PROJECT>_<ENV>, modules/snowflake/warehouse/main.tf), so a second size would be a second warehouse with the same name.

code.description: Short code for the compute profile (empty string for default)

name.description: Human-readable name of the compute profile

desc.description: Description of the compute profile's purpose

alias.description: Alternative name or abbreviation for the compute profile

disabled.description: Whether this compute profile is disabled and unavailable for use

required.description: Whether this compute profile must be created for every project

sizes.description: Available warehouse sizes for this compute profile
